purpose: Source-backed offline PM Return preparation: conservative document authority, immutable state-equality snapshot, stable submission identity and parameterized SQL command factory. Runtime gateway remains unregistered.
historical_scope_note: Preserve historical B01/PR50 claims and files. This is bounded new-file direct work under the newer sole-root direction, not a takeover or an unclaimed lane.
sql_policy: Static read of owner-authorized local source only; no SQL connection or execution, migrations, schema/data changes, credentials or raw-source publication
publication_policy: Single parent publisher; isolated local worker, independent review and exact head/base CI. No server/DNS/ACL/certificate/deployment changes.
constraints: Only listed new files; no shared fingerprint v1 changes
No API endpoints, capability grants, DI gateway registration, FE or readiness changes
Caller-owned SERIALIZABLE transaction; no internal commit/dispose
State equality token is not monotonic version, ABA protection or stale UI proof
No runtime journal/gateway or Web-only lock qualification
